positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
• Maintained and modified MSC enterprise architecture data using IBM System Architect

positions.description:

•	Maintained and enhanced an FDA web application and database using Oracle Application Express
•	Modeled FDA enterprise architecture data using Troux Architect
•	Participated in enterprise architecture data calls with FDA investment owners

positions.title: Junior Programmer

•	Tested Jin 1.1.0, a J2EE software via spreadsheet test reports
•	Maintain and build J2EE applications using Borland JBuilder
